name: Shieldwall Breaker (Combat)
body:
You are skilled at breaking the shieldwall formations of others.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Wall*, base attack bonus +5

Benefit(s): Make a bull rush or charge action against one member of a shieldwall. If you succeed in your attack, that person and the shieldwall members to the immediate left and right of him lose any bonus from the Shield Wall feat until the end of your next turn. However, if part of a shieldwall, you also lose your bonus from that feat until the end of the next turn.
